app.name: MedSure Vision
app.tagline: Smart medicine screening for safer verification
app.positioningNotice: First-line screening tool. MedSure compares details with its catalogue and does not confirm that a medicine is genuine or safe. Consult a pharmacist.

scan.title: Verify a medicine
scan.subtitle: Scan the medicine pack to check whether its details match records in the MedSure catalogue.
scan.guidance: Place the medicine name, batch number and expiry area inside the frame.
scan.processing: Analyzing packaging and comparing with master catalog...
scan.dropImage: Drop medicine packaging image here or click to browse
scan.uploadHint: Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP (Strip, Box, or Label)

search.title: Medicine Catalogue Search
search.placeholder: Search medicine, composition or brand (e.g. Dolo, Paracetamol, Crocin)
search.noResults: No medicines found matching your search.

match.title: Matches a catalogue record
match.desc: The details provided correspond to a record in the MedSure catalogue.

alert.title: Regulatory alert found
alert.desc: An active CDSCO regulatory alert exists for this batch. Do not dispense — consult a pharmacist.

needsVerification.title: Needs verification
needsVerification.desc: One or more details do not fully match the catalogue record. Manual check required.

noRecord.badge: No matching record in the MedSure catalogue
noRecord.title: No matching record in the MedSure catalogue
noRecord.desc: No record was found matching the provided details. The medicine may not be in the MedSure catalogue.

insufficient.title: Insufficient input
insufficient.desc: Not enough information was provided to attempt verification. Please provide a medicine name, barcode, or batch number.

receiving.title: Receive Medicine
receiving.subtitle: Verify medicines before adding them to inventory.
receiving.scanPrompt: Verify a pack first to add it to the receiving ledger.
receiving.empty: No medicines in receiving ledger yet. Screen a medicine to add it.

history.title: Verification History
history.subtitle: Audit log of all scanned and verified medicine packages.

filters.noRecord: No matching record in the MedSure catalogue

alerts.title: Regulatory NSQ Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Authoritative CDSCO and State Drug Control NSQ alerts from backend.
